_comment: NOT from the source prototype, which shipped no audio — added during the port; see docs/SOUND_GUIDE.md. Keys must match Audio.EVENTS exactly (tests/test_audio.gd enforces it in both directions). Every sound here is a PLACEHOLDER, synthesized by tests/gen_sounds.py, and is meant to be replaced. 'file' is optional and defaults to assets/audio/<event>.wav; a bare filename resolves under assets/audio/, a res:// or user:// path is taken as-is, so a mod can point at its own folder. 'gain_db' trims a sound that lands too loud without re-rendering it. 'pitch_jitter' varies pitch by +/- that fraction per play so a run of the same sound (five cards dealt in a row) does not machine-gun.
